question: After Mahatma Gandhi's release from prison in January 1931, Congress leaders met at ______ to plan the future course of action.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Allahabad.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• After Mahatma Gandhi's release from prison in January 1931, **Congress leaders met at Allahabad** to plan the future course of action.
 
• Gandhi Ji began his Dandi March from his** Asharam in Sabarmati** in order to break the salt law, by manufacturing their own salt in Dandi.
 
• **Salt March** also known as **Dandi March** was initiated by Mahatma Gandhi.
 
• It was started on 12 March 1930 and rallied for 24 days at Sabarmati near Ahmedabad.
 
• Gandhiji and more than thousands of people got arrested while making their own salt as a protest against British rule and British taxation of salt production to make it legal and tax-free.
 
• It ultimately turned into a victory when the British unleashed the protesters from prison and granted the people to make their own salt.
